shared_interfaces.payload: decode_counted_asm_name(record,*,allow_empty_names=False); opt-in empty term name only after typed child validation
shared_interfaces.nested_scope: Empty-name children are ignored validated metadata, never topology tags or naming-match candidates
shared_interfaces.vertex_match_scope: Match candidates use actual typed VERTEX membership in body_graph.vertex_indices, not edge_indices

observed_grammar.empty_child: Exactly17tokens; pointer[-1],integer[-1],next/previous pointers[-1,-1],parent custom-attribute owner pointer; generic definition/schema3,3,-1/namespace; one term: explicitname length0,string empty,index0,componentcount1,positive signed32 component,zero terminator. Parent field0 points to this child; parent topology owner is BODY or FACE.
observed_grammar.vertex_generic: Existing counted generic schema with one nonempty decimal name,index0,one positive component and zero terminator. Typed VERTEX attribute head/sibling chain reciprocates every owner.
observed_grammar.FACE_FPM: Exactly8tokens, standard custom attribute header, FPM_tracked_attrib_def,integer schema1,positive uint32-range integer literal. Typed FACE attribute chain reciprocates owner; value remains an unqualified tracking literal.

limitations: Empty term names are observed only in the exact singleton child metadata layout. They do not add an unnamed topology candidate or establish a native object ID.
Generic naming tuple matches establish serialized correspondence only; duplicates are retained. The synthetic tuple probes below are validator controls, not captured native selection recipes.
FPM values remain literal uint32-range integers; neither matching a feature ID numerically nor repeating across faces establishes feature ownership or historical state.
Header-child links, sibling links, topology pointers and native Design object IDs remain distinct explicit namespaces.
Occurrence counts refer to the saved34-file frontier subset, not a complete-format coverage claim.
